annotation.title_en: The Thief Maid and Georgi Smbatich
annotation.summary_en: An employer catches his maid stealing money and threatens to call the police unless she can impress him with a special 'trick' to make amends.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in an apartment living room furnished with a china cabinet and wall art. An employer, Georgi Smbatich, confronts his maid, accusing her of stealing from his salary payments. He threatens to call the police ('1-02'). The maid, played by a young woman, becomes desperate and begs him not to call, offering to return the money, work for free for a year, and handle all household chores like laundry and ironing. When Georgi Smbatich remains unmoved and begins dialing the police, the maid promises to perform a 'firmayin' (signature) trick that he will never forget to compensate for her actions. An eccentric man with a blond wig and glasses is involved in the heated exchange as she tries to stop the call. She attempts various maneuvers, including what she calls 'giving him a start' (khodi tal), but the elderly man with a cane repeatedly complains that nothing is working. Despite her efforts to distract or please him with her 'tricks,' the employer remains dissatisfied and continues to threaten her with the authorities.
catchphrases: հիմա նենց բան կանեմ որ դուք ամբողջ կյանքում չեք մոռանա
հեսա ձեզ խոդի կտամ պապի ջան
